en: A black and white photograph depicting a quiet, cobblestone street lined with historic stone buildings. The main structure in the background is a large building with a steeply sloped roof, arched windows, and a distinctive bell tower, suggesting religious or civic significance. Several people are visible on the street, including women in late 19th or early 20th century attire and a group of boys, creating a lively but peaceful urban scene.
